workflow: Open WIPI File: native ARM WIPI JAR or ZIP containing JAR
Select Language; EN/custom translations use editable TXT. KR uses original resources.
Check Error: validate translations only, writing error.txt on failure. Disabled for KR.
Create Game Folder: explicitly produce zenonia2nds/ from the selection.
Build once with build.bat or make. Result: Zenonia 2 DS Runner.nds, game code #### unchanged.
Copy the NDS and entire zenonia2nds/ folder to the flashcard root.
english_edits: Existing en/ edits are preserved. Missing en/ is restored from the bundled text seed.
